thread:
carmen: Heads-up from support: Org Z reported a 500 on /v1/embeddings but their usage spike hit a per-route quota. They expected a 429.
lee: can we get the raw resp/headers?
carmen: ```http
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route-Name: embeddings-global-2
X-Quota-Verifier: deferred
X-Trace: trace-8932
{ "error": "backend_unreachable" }
```
rita: looks like quota enforcement happened in the route after gateway forwarded. Gateway currently only emits 429 when it blocks at ingress. Late checks leak infra 5xx to callers.
omar: This breaks client-side semantics. Clients treat 5xx as server retryable and will hammer the API. We need a consistent contract: quota -> 429, infra -> 5xx.
maru: Quick proposal: annotate the final error path with a structured "client_status" tag (quota|infra|unknown) that flows back to the gateway. Gateway should normalize the outward HTTP status where possible and add stable headers: `X-Client-Status: quota` or `X-Client-Status: infra`. Also add `X-Quota-Detail: tenant_limit` when quota.
lee: re streaming: for chunked responses we can't change status mid-flight. Instead emit a final control chunk `{"event":"end","client_status":"quota","code":429}` and close. Document SDK behavior.
rita: telemetry ask: add a new metric `client_visible_status_total` with labels: `client_status`, `quota_origin` (ingress|route|none), `route`, `subcode`. Dashboards should show percent of 5xx that have `client_status=quota`.
omar: UX: Console should show a per-route "quota impact" flag when >1% of errors are quota-mapped, with an action link to request quota increases and a timeline of quota hits. Keep copy minimal: "This route limited by tenant quota. See Quotas."
maru: Rollout: feature-flag `client_status_propagation` starting in gateway and route proxies. Canary at 5% for 12h, then 25% for 24h. Signals: 1) 429 increase, 2) 5xx decrease where appropriate, 3) SDK error classification mismatch alerts. Add a PagerDuty playbook if we see >10% traffic experiencing stream truncation.
lee: SDKs: update docs to prefer the `X-Client-Status` header and to watch for the terminal control chunk in streams. Recommend clients treat `X-Client-Status: quota` as immediate backoff with exponential jitter.
rita: We must also keep an `internal_cause` log field that holds the original infra code so SREs can find root cause without guessing. Logs should include `client_status` and `internal_cause`.
omar: Can we add a lightweight validation test in integration harness that simulates deferred quota and checks the gateway's outward status + headers?
maru: Yes, will add an integration that spins up a fake route which returns `quota: true` in final decision and asserts gateway emits 429 + header. Also add stream test for control chunk.
lee: ownership: @maru implements propagation schema + tests, @rita updates telemetry + dashboard tiles, @omar updates console text + support snippet, @carmen will draft the support message and follow up with Org Z, @lee updates SDK docs.
devops-bot: deploy started: feat/client-status-prop -> gateway-canary (5%)
maru: PR linked in #pull-requests. Added schema proto and gateway translation layer.
rita: dashboard mock uploaded to Figma; landing panel shows "Quota vs infra errors" breakdown.
omar: customer comm: short note explaining root cause + upcoming fix. Keep it factual and include workaround (rate limit backoff).
lee: good. Also add a note to the changelog about the new headers so integrators are aware.
maru: I'll monitor canary and report back after 12h. If the stream end chunk causes any unexpected client failures we'll pause.
carmen: thanks all. let's keep messages threaded in the PR for naming + copy consistency.
